skill.name: child-agent-ops
skill.description: Standardizes how to launch, assign, monitor, and report child agents for Codex workflows.
skill.summary: Provides a repeatable operating process for coordinated child-agent work.

content.value_statement: Parallel AI work fails when roles, checkpoints, and reports are unclear. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code teams a repeatable child-agent operating process.
actual_capabilities: Defines leader, implementation, and review agent responsibilities.
Provides a standard workflow for splitting and assigning child-agent tasks.
Lists approval checkpoints for security, billing, deletion, and compatibility risks.
Supplies report templates for task status and child-agent launch logs.
Requires review-agent involvement when code is changed or created.
limitations: Does not execute commands or create child agents by itself.
Does not provide an orchestration API or automation framework.
Assumes users already understand the supported AI tools.
Does not replace human approval for high-risk changes.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Parallel Implementation
use_cases.description: Split an engineering task into clear child-agent assignments with completion criteria and checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Standardize Agent Reporting
use_cases.description: Use consistent status reports so blockers, risks, and next actions are easy to track.

use_cases.title: Add Review Coverage
use_cases.description: Trigger review-agent work when code changes need independent assessment before completion.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Assignment
prompt_templates.prompt: Use child-agent-ops to define one child-agent assignment for this task. Include purpose, scope, completion criteria, and expected duration.

prompt_templates.title: Split Work Across Agents
prompt_templates.prompt: Use child-agent-ops to split this project into leader, implementation, and review responsibilities. Include checkpoints and reporting expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Review Operational Risk
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply child-agent-ops to identify which parts of this plan require leader approval before a child agent continues.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Full Agent Operation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use child-agent-ops to produce a complete operating plan for multiple child agents, including launch logs, checkpoint timing, escalation rules, and final reports.

output_examples.input: Plan child-agent work for a small refactor.
output_examples.output: A leader plan with scoped implementation and review assignments, clear completion criteria, and checkpoint notes.

output_examples.input: Report progress from a delegated investigation.
output_examples.output: A concise task report covering purpose, current status, open issues, risks, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Decide whether a child agent can proceed without approval.
output_examples.output: A decision note that separates autonomous work from changes needing leader review, such as security or compatibility impact.

best_practices: Define completion criteria before launching any child agent.
Escalate unclear security, billing, deletion, or compatibility risks early.
Record final outputs, remaining risks, and next actions in one place.
anti_patterns: Launching child agents without a defined owner or scope.
Letting parallel agents modify overlapping files without coordination.
Skipping review-agent checks after code changes.

faq.question: Does this skill create child agents automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides an operating process and templates for users who run supported tools.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Is this only for software projects?
faq.answer: It is written for coding workflows, but the reporting structure can fit other technical tasks.

faq.question: When should a leader approve work?
faq.answer: Leader approval is recommended for unclear specifications, API impact, security risk, billing impact, or data deletion.

faq.question: Does it include report templates?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes task reporting and child-agent launch log templates.

faq.question: How does it improve safety?
faq.answer: It defines role boundaries, escalation points, review steps, and shutdown expectations for unused child agents.
